svg.title: Anatomy of the Profile page
svg.desc: Panels showing a risk score ring, an AI verdict, a behavioural fingerprint radar, a list of repeating patterns with frequency bars, a win-rate heatmap by weekday and hour, and a year-long activity heatmap.
svg.text: THE PROFILE PAGE — WHAT EACH PANEL MEASURES
One line on what to work on today
Win rate by weekday and hour
No figures are shown here. Every panel describes behaviour, not balances.
